The coalition said it hit smuggling and weapons-transporting operations in Hodeida while also carrying out attacks in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz governorates, marking an uptick after months of hostilities.

ai.sum: The Saudi-led coalition launched a special operation striking Hodeidah and other Houthi-held areas, and the Houthis vowed reprisals.

Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis have intensified drone and missile strikes on Saudi airports, oil facilities and office buildings, raising questions about Riyadh's ability to secure nuclear plants that…
